properties.name: Chandrapur STPS + Dhariwal
properties.members: Mahagenco Chandrapur STPS (3,340 MW in GPPD; 2,920 MW now), Dhariwal Tadali (600 MW)
properties.fgd_note: Category B, case-by-case (Jul 2025 notification as reported by The News Dirt (16 Jul 2025)). CSTPS asked for a review of its SO₂ norm in Jan 2026 (Mahagenco EC compliance report). Mahagenco targeted FGD on its 500 MW units for Jan–Jul 2026 (annual report 2023-24); commissioning not confirmed.

properties.name: Koradi + Khaparkheda
properties.members: Mahagenco Koradi (2,400 MW), Mahagenco Khaparkheda (1,340 MW), 4 km apart
properties.fgd_note: Exempt, over 10 km from Nagpur (Jul 2025 notification as reported by The News Dirt (16 Jul 2025)). FGD for Koradi units 8–10 (3×660 MW) awarded Nov 2023, targeted May 2026 (Mahagenco annual report 2023-24); EC deadline 31 Dec 2026. Commissioning not confirmed.

properties.name: Tiroda (Adani)
properties.fgd_note: Category C, exempt (Jul 2025 notification as reported by The News Dirt (16 Jul 2025)).

properties.name: Mauda (NTPC)
properties.fgd_note: Category C, exempt (Jul 2025 notification as reported by The News Dirt (16 Jul 2025)), but NTPC built wet limestone FGD anyway (Mitsubishi Power contract, 2018); FGD and gypsum units shown in service in Oct 2026 (The Live Nagpur, 23 Oct 2026). The satellite ratio falls from early 2025.

properties.name: Bhusawal (Deepnagar)
properties.fgd_note: Mahagenco listed Bhusawal 500 MW units for FGD in Jan–Jul 2026 (annual report 2023-24); status not confirmed.

properties.name: Parli
properties.fgd_note: Tender floated for wet FGD on units 6–7 (Mahagenco annual report 2024-25).

properties.name: Amravati (RattanIndia)
properties.fgd_note: Exempt (Jul 2025 notification as reported by The News Dirt (16 Jul 2025)).

properties.name: Warora (GMR + Sai Wardha)
properties.members: GMR Warora (600 MW), Sai Wardha Warora (540 MW), same site
properties.fgd_note: Exempt (Jul 2025 notification as reported by The News Dirt (16 Jul 2025)).

properties.name: Butibori
properties.fgd_note: Exempt (Jul 2025 notification as reported by The News Dirt (16 Jul 2025)).

properties.name: Paras
properties.fgd_note: Category B, 5 km from Akola (Jul 2025 notification as reported by The News Dirt (16 Jul 2025)). FGD on units 3–4 69% complete, targeted Apr 2026 (Mahagenco annual report 2024-25); commissioning not confirmed.

properties.name: Dahanu (Adani)
properties.fgd_note: Seawater FGD on both units, ordered 2005 (Ducon; Power Engineering). A reference plant with a scrubber.

properties.name: Trombay–Chembur
properties.members: Tata Power Trombay (750 MW coal), BPCL and HPCL refineries, RCF fertiliser complex
properties.fgd_note: Tata Power runs a seawater FGD (MPCB consent 2012). Refineries and RCF are in the same satellite footprint; Mumbai's traffic adds NO₂.

properties.name: Tarapur MIDC
properties.members: ~1,300 chemical, pharma and steel units (CEPI score 93.7)
properties.fgd_note: Critically polluted area (CPCB CEPI). Dahanu power plant is 16 km north.

properties.name: Taloja MIDC
properties.members: Chemical, pharma and steel units (Navi Mumbai CEPI area)
properties.fgd_note: Part of the Navi Mumbai critically polluted area (CPCB CEPI).

properties.name: Ghugus–Rajura cement belt
properties.members: UltraTech Awarpur, Ambuja Maratha, Manikgarh, ACC Chanda cement plants
properties.fgd_note: Cement is under the Carbon Credit Trading Scheme intensity targets (Oct 2025). Chandrapur STPS is 25 km north.
